Zoe: Did a ~2h replay from prod traces on branch kernel-selector-v2. Quick summary: p99 for short sequences (<64) increased noticeably (~8% uplift) and global p99 up ~3%. Small parity mismatches ~0.6% of requests, usually single-token diffs. Suspect the new selector chooses a fused kernel on certain short batches after our KV warmup tweak.

Zoe: Replay command (sanitized):
```
./replay-runner \
  --trace-path s3://prod-traces/2026/03/14/ \
  --code-ref kernel-selector-v2 \
  --anon=prefix_length_bucketed \
  --kv-warmup-mode auto-detect \
  --random-seed 2026 \
  --output /tmp/replay-kv-test
```

Zoe: Anon choices: prefix-hash + length buckets to preserve seq length distribution. We keep consistent cohort salts so replays are deterministic per cohort. Harness doesn't rewrite batching boundaries.

Raj: Can you paste a minimal parity log + kernel pick so we can see if it's numerical drift vs path selection?

Zoe: Pasted an example (sanitized):
```
[TRACE=9f1b2c] seq_len=28 cohort=short bucket=3 salt_id=12 kernel=fused-attn-32 kv_state=warm
[TRACE=9f1b2c] rerun(forced_kernel=unfused-attn) -> kernel=unfused-attn block_cfg=blk32_algo7 p99_ms_delta=+0.7 parity=1-token-diff
[TRACE=9f1b2c] golden: "... the quick brown <TKN> jumps ..."
[TRACE=9f1b2c] rerun:  "... the quick brown <TKN> jumpz ..."
```

Sasha: That pattern smells like small FP rounding differences in fused path for short attention windows. Could be occupancy/wave divergence on boundaries that only triggers for certain token alignments.

Matt: If we force the selector to the old policy (env FORCE_KERNEL=unfused-attn) and re-run the exact cohorts, do we recover baseline latency and parity?

Zoe: I did a quick forced run on 2 short cohorts with FORCE_KERNEL=unfused-attn. Tail latency for those cohorts returned to baseline and parity mismatches dropped to 0 for those cohorts. So kernel selection is the likely culprit.

Raj: Two asks: 1) Add exact kernel config (algo id, block sizes, data-type) into the trace metadata so we can reproduce exact kernel picks. Right now we only store family names. 2) Run warmup variations (kv_warmup=full vs kv_warmup=none) to see interaction effects.

Zoe: Will do. Planning 4 replays to isolate variables:
- old-selector + kv_warmup=full
- old-selector + kv_warmup=none
- kernel-selector-v2 + kv_warmup=full
- kernel-selector-v2 + kv_warmup=none

replay-bot: Scheduled job replay-2062345678-compare-4variants. ETA ~50m. CI link: https://ci.internal/redwood/replay/2062345678

Sasha: Also suggests a synthetic microbench matching the short-batch distribution (seq_len 16/32/48) with deterministic token patterns so we can rule out token-content dependent edge cases.

Matt: I'll run the microbench on an isolated rack to avoid noisy neighbors. I'll collect perf counters: SM occupancy, warp efficiency, L2 hit/miss, memory throughput, and nvprof traces. Will try fused vs unfused kernels.

Zoe: Plan recap: add kernel-config fields to runner output (algo_id, block_size, datatype, launch_params), run 4 replays, kick off Matt's microbench, then reconvene. If we confirm small numeric drift but perf win or neutral, we could gate fused-attn-32 behind a rollout flag and tune kernels. If perf regression persists, roll back selector for short cohorts.

Raj: Please also attach a small quality eval (prompt set) to the replay jobs so we can measure downstream quality delta for those 1-token changes. If it is within our tolerance, engineering can make a call; otherwise we block rollout.

Zoe: Adding a quality eval to the replay CI matrix. I'll post the run artifacts + a concise diff summary when they finish. :thumbsup:

Matt: FYI I'll upload nvprof flamegraphs and raw counters to the replay job artifacts. Expect occupancy to differ ~10-15% between fused/unfused in short batches based on earlier micro runs.

Sasha: If occupancy is the issue, kernel tuning (tile size / shared memory use) should help. Might also try a hybrid kernel for seq<48 fallback.

Zoe: OK scheduling tasks: (1) add kernel-config logging to runner (me), (2) queue 4 replays (me + replay-bot), (3) microbench perf run with counters (Matt), (4) quality eval attached (me). Will update thread with links.

Raj: Thanks. If anyone sees larger parity deltas or an uptick in failures, ping incidents channel and pause rollout.

Zoe: Noted. Posting interim artifacts when available.
